verses.ar: قَصِيدَةٌ لِدَاوُدَ لَمَّا كَانَ فِي ٱلْمَغَارَةِ. صَلَاةٌ
verses.en: Maschil of David, when he was in the cave; a Prayer.
verses.kjv: Maschil of David; A Prayer when he was in the cave.
verses.web: A contemplation by David, when he was in the cave. A Prayer.

verses.he: קֹ֭ולִי אֶל־יְהוָ֣ה אֶזְעָ֑ק קֹ֝ולִ֗י אֶל־יְהוָ֥ה אֶתְחַנָּֽן׃
verses.ar: بِصَوْتِي إِلَى ٱلرَّبِّ أَصْرُخُ. بِصَوْتِي إِلَى ٱلرَّبِّ أَتَضَرَّعُ.
verses.en: With my voice I cry unto the LORD; with my voice I make supplication unto the LORD.
verses.kjv: I cried unto the LORD with my voice; with my voice unto the LORD did I make my supplication.
verses.web: I cry with my voice to Yahweh. With my voice, I ask Yahweh for mercy.

verses.he: אֶשְׁפֹּ֣ךְ לְפָנָ֣יו שִׂיחִ֑י צָ֝רָתִ֗י לְפָנָ֥יו אַגִּֽיד׃
verses.ar: أَسْكُبُ أَمَامَهُ شَكْوَايَ. بِضِيقِيْ قُدَّامَهُ أُخْبِرُ.
verses.en: I pour out my complaint before Him, I declare before Him my trouble;
verses.kjv: I poured out my complaint before him; I shewed before him my trouble.
verses.web: I pour out my complaint before him. I tell him my troubles.

verses.he: בְּהִתְעַטֵּ֬ף עָלַ֨י ׀ רוּחִ֗י וְאַתָּה֮ יָדַ֪עְתָּ נְֽתִיבָ֫תִ֥י בְּאֹֽרַח־ז֥וּ אֲהַלֵּ֑ךְ טָמְנ֖וּ פַ֣ח לִֽי׃
verses.ar: عِنْدَ مَا أَعْيَتْ رُوحِي فِيَّ، وَأَنْتَ عَرَفْتَ مَسْلَكِي. فِي ٱلطَّرِيقِ ٱلَّتِي أَسْلُكُ أَخْفَوْا لِي فَخًّا.
verses.en: When my spirit fainteth within me — Thou knowest my path — in the way wherein I walk have they hidden a snare for me.
verses.kjv: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walked have they privily laid a snare for me.
verses.web: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my route. On the path in which I walk, they have hidden a snare for me.

verses.he: הַבֵּ֤יט יָמִ֨ין ׀ וּרְאֵה֮ וְאֵֽין־לִ֪י מַ֫כִּ֥יר אָבַ֣ד מָנֹ֣וס מִמֶּ֑נִּי אֵ֖ין דֹּורֵ֣שׁ לְנַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.ar: ٱنْظُرْ إِلَى ٱلْيَمِينِ وَأَبْصِرْ، فَلَيْسَ لِي عَارِفٌ. بَادَ عَنِّي ٱلْمَنَاصُ. لَيْسَ مَنْ يَسْأَلُ عَنْ نَفْسِي.
verses.en: Look on my right hand, and see, for there is no man that knoweth me; I have no way to flee; no man careth for my soul.
verses.kjv: I looked on [my] right hand, and beheld, but [there was] no man that would know me: refuge failed me; no man cared for my soul.
verses.web: Look on my right, and see; for there is no one who is concerned for me. Refuge has fled from me. No one cares for my soul.

verses.he: זָעַ֥קְתִּי אֵלֶ֗יךָ יְה֫וָ֥ה אָ֭מַרְתִּי אַתָּ֣ה מַחְסִ֑י חֶ֝לְקִ֗י בְּאֶ֣רֶץ הַֽחַיִּים׃
verses.ar: صَرَخْتُ إِلَيْكَ يَارَبُّ. قُلْتُ: «أَنْتَ مَلْجَإِي، نَصِيبِي فِي أَرْضِ ٱلْأَحْيَاءِ».
verses.en: I have cried unto Thee, O LORD; I have said: 'Thou art my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.'
verses.kjv: I cried unto thee, O LORD: I said, Thou [art] my refuge [and] my portion in the land of the living.
verses.web: I cried to you, Yahweh. I said, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”

verses.he: הַקְשִׁ֤יבָה ׀ אֶֽל־רִנָּתִי֮ כִּֽי־דַלֹּ֪ותִ֫י מְאֹ֥ד הַצִּילֵ֥נִי מֵרֹדְפַ֑י כִּ֖י אָמְצ֣וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.ar: أَصْغِ إِلَى صُرَاخِي، لِأَنِّي قَدْ تَذَلَّلْتُ جِدًّا. نَجِّنِي مِنْ مُضْطَهِدِيَّ، لِأَنَّهُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنِّي.
verses.en: Attend unto my cry; for I am brought very low; deliver me from my persecutors; for they are too strong for me.
verses.kjv: Attend unto my cry; for I am brought very low: deliver me from my persecutors; for they are stronger than I.
verses.web: Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need. Deliver me from my persecutors, for they are too strong for me.

verses.he: הֹ֘וצִ֤יאָה מִמַּסְגֵּ֨ר ׀ נַפְשִׁי֮ לְהֹודֹ֪ות אֶת־שְׁ֫מֶ֥ךָ בִּ֭י יַכְתִּ֣רוּ צַדִּיקִ֑ים כִּ֖י תִגְמֹ֣ל עָלֽ͏ָי׃
verses.ar: أَخْرِجْ مِنَ ٱلْحَبْسِ نَفْسِي، لِتَحْمِيدِ ٱسْمِكَ. ٱلصِّدِّيقُونَ يَكْتَنِفُونَنِي، لِأَنَّكَ تُحْسِنُ إِلَيَّ.
verses.en: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks unto Thy name; the righteous shall crown themselves because of me; for Thou wilt deal bountifully with me.
verses.kjv: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise thy name: the righteous shall compass me about; for thou shalt deal bountifully with me.
verses.web: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to your name. The righteous will surround me, for you will be good to me.
